13.
(1) A new Higher Educational Institution shall apply
for accreditation of such institution under section 11 within
a period of five years from the receipt of the certificate of
initial clearance prior to the enrollment of students.
(2)  A  Higher  Educational  Institution  referred  to  in  the
proviso to section 11, shall, after the lapse of a period of five
years from the date on which this Act comes into operation,
apply for accreditation of such institution under section 11.
(3) Where a Higher Educational Institution  existing on
the  day  immediately  preceding  the  date  of  coming  into
operation  of  this  Act  other  than  the  Higher  Educational
Institutions referred to in the proviso to section 11–
